title: Prioritize current actionable alerts over stale peers
implementation: Adjusted Multi-Site health ranking so a fresh critical/degraded Site outranks a stale alert of the same severity.
Preserved the existing stale-first visibility rule for non-actionable states such as stale healthy history.
Added regression coverage for both current-versus-stale actionable ordering and the existing stale visibility behavior.

verification.tddRed: The new ranking test initially returned stale-critical before current-critical.
verification.siteHealthRegression: 86/88 passed; the two failures were socket_AccessDenied loopback health-probe tests caused by the sandbox boundary.

boundary: Loopback health-probe execution remains unavailable in this sandbox, so two live-socket tests remain environment-blocked.

Authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive verification, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain externally unverified.
